title: Prep the Dataset
briefMd:
# Prep the Dataset

You are reviewing a **frozen sample** of train/eval rows before a LoRA job. The full set is not uploaded — only these rows are visible in the brief.

| id | split | prompt (truncated) |
|---|---|---|
| tr-01 | train | Refund policy for annual plans |
| tr-02 | train | Cancel subscription within 14 days |
| tr-05 | train | Cancel subscription within 14 days |
| ev-01 | eval | Cancel subscription within 14 days |
| ev-02 | eval | Upgrade from Basic to Pro |

Pass when you name the **issue type** and list every **train row id** that must be fixed before training.
